snippet.title: Bloodbane: The Crimson Nocturne - Command your servant, harvest blood and slay an ancient vampire!
snippet.description:
Play for free on itch.io https://hvdr02.itch.io/bloodbane-the-crimson-nocturne-post-ludum-ver?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Play as a vampire ruling from the safety of your castle, directing your unruly servant with magical pings.But your servant has a mind of their own: they will not always obey, and excessive commands will only drive them into a rage.

Scavenge for resources, collect equipment, and carefully manage your servant’s temper as you prepare to face and defeat a rival vampire lord.
